software_class: coordinated agent workflow with roles, authority boundaries, and verification gates

options.name: Orchestrator and workers
options.when_to_use: A central controller can route bounded tasks to specialized roles.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when peer coordination is required.
options.rationale: Keeps authority and audit path clear.

options.name: Planner executor verifier loop
options.when_to_use: High-risk output requires explicit review before action.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when latency matters more than assurance.
options.tradeoffs: More steps and artifacts are required.
options.risks: Verifier criteria can be too shallow.

options.name: Evented agent system
options.when_to_use: Agents react to durable events and long-running workflows.
options.risks: Event storms and retries need careful limits.
